content.text: (b) Using SST, replace the No. 2 bearing, using the No. 1 bearing as a guide.
When inserting the bearings, align each oil hole.

content.description: Illustration showing a feeler gauge being used to measure thrust clearance between thrust plate and collar on drive shaft.

content.text: 3. INSPECT OIL PUMP DRIVE SHAFT THRUST CLEARANCE
Using a feeler gauge, measure the drive shaft thrust clearance between the thrust plate and collar.
If clearance is greater than maximum, replace the thrust plate and/or collar.

content.description: Illustration showing SST tool being used to remove thrust plate and collar from oil pump drive shaft.

content.text: 4. IF NECESSARY, REPLACE THRUST PLATE AND COLLAR
(a) Using SST, remove the thrust plate and collar.

content.description: Illustration showing thrust plate, collar, and other components laid out separately, with a press being used to install them.

content.text: (b) Install the thrust plate and collar in the order as shown.
(c) Using a press, install the thrust plate and collar.

content.description: Illustration showing a hand using a tool to drive out the oil pump guide bushing from the outer side of the cylinder block.

content.text: 5. IF NECESSARY, REPLACE OIL PUMP GUIDE BUSHING
(a) Drive out the bushing from the outer side of the block.
